16:7.text: And they carry your loads to a land that you could not reach except with great trouble to yourselves. Truly, your Lord is full of Kindness, Most Merciful.

16:8.text: horses, mules and donkeys, for you to ride and as an adornment. And He creates
things of which you have no knowledge.

16:9.text: And upon Allâh is the responsibility to explain the Straight Path
. But there are ways that turn aside
. And had He willed, He would have guided you all

16:10.text: He it is Who sends down water
from the sky; from it you drink and from it
the vegetation on which you send your cattle to pasture.

16:11.text: With it He causes to grow for you the crops, the olives, the date-palms, the grapes, and every kind of fruit. Verily! In this is indeed an evident proof and a manifest sign for people who give thought.

16:12.text: And He has subjected to you the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; and the stars are subjected by His Command. Surely, in this are proofs for people who understand.

16:13.text: And whatsoever He has created for you on the earth of varying colours
[and qualities from vegetation and fruits (botanical life) and from animals (zoological life)]
Verily! In this is a sign for people who remember.

16:14.text: And He it is Who has subjected the sea
, that you eat thereof fresh tender meat
, and that you bring forth out of it ornaments to wear. And you see the ships ploughing through it, that you may seek
(by transporting the goods from place to place)
and that you may be grateful.
